مَاذِىٌّ * (K) and مَاذِيَّةٌ (S, L, Msb, K) A soft coat of mail, easy to the wearer; (S, L, Msb, K;) and [so] the former, any weapon: (K:) or the latter, a white coat of mail. (Msb.) ― -b2- Hence, (Msb,) the latter, White honey: (S, L, Msb, K:) or [in the CK and] new honey: or pure honey: or excellent honey. (K.) ― -b3- Also, the latter, Wine. (S, L, K.)
مَأَى * (like مَاءَ) It (a cat) mewed. (TA, voce مَاءَ, art. موأ.)
مَاذِىٌّ * Honey: (K:) or white honey: (S, M:) or fine, or thin, white honey. (AA, TA.)
